text: [calm, natural narrator voice] On small test problems, it partly works. The mirror holds by construction, at every setting. On three dials, the rate of zero crossings is roughly right far from the threshold, and poor near it. A smooth machine rounds off a steep change. The bigger tests, in three dimensions and in the shapes of real machines, are written as bets.
